alerts.title: Someone is trying to knock customers off your WiFi
alerts.explanation: A nearby device is repeatedly disconnecting people from your WiFi. This is sometimes done to push customers onto a fake copy of your network. It is worth a quick look today.
alerts.recommended_action: Ask staff whether customers are reporting disconnections.

alerts.title: An unknown wireless network appeared nearby
alerts.explanation: We spotted a WiFi network near your shop that we don't recognize. It is often just a neighbor's device, but it is worth checking. Nothing needs to change on your WiFi right now.
alerts.recommended_action: Ask staff if anyone has set up a new hotspot or device nearby.

alerts.title: A copy of your WiFi network has appeared
alerts.explanation: Someone near your front counter is broadcasting a network with the same name as yours, 'NileCorner_WiFi'. Customers who connect to it could have their information stolen. This needs your attention right now.
alerts.recommended_action: Ask staff to remind customers to only connect to the WiFi name printed at the counter.

alerts.explanation: لاحظنا نشاطًا غير معتاد قرب مكتب الاستقبال. لا يبدو خطيرًا حتى الآن. سنواصل المراقبة.
alerts.recommended_action: لا يلزمك أي إجراء الآن، وأبلغنا إذا لاحظت بطئًا في الإنترنت.

alerts.title: ظهرت شبكة لاسلكية غير معروفة بالقرب منكم

alerts.recommended_action: اسأل موظفي الاستقبال إن كانت هناك طابعة أو جهاز جديد تم تشغيله مؤخرًا.
